layout: Single step screen. Light bg (#F8FAFC). Clean, professional feel. IDENTICAL LAYOUT to other steps — only content area changes.

layout_structure.top_bar: Back arrow (top-left, active navy #003F8C). No skip link.
layout_structure.progress: Step indicator centered: 4 dot circles. Steps 1-3: GREEN (#22C55E) filled. Step 4: ORANGE (#FF8A34) filled.
layout_structure.illustration: Large clipboard/checklist icon centered, ~80px, in blue (#003F8C)
layout_structure.heading: 'Review & Submit' — navy (#0B1B3B), h2 (24px), bold, centered
layout_structure.subtitle: 'Periksa data sebelum dikirim ke admin' — slate (#64748B), body (16px), centered
layout_structure.content_area: Summary sections with edit links, agreement + signature
layout_structure.cta: Button 'Submit for Review' — orange (#FF8A34), full width. DISABLED until agreement checked + signature drawn.
layout_structure.spacing: 24px between sections. 16px horizontal padding mobile, 32px desktop.

elements: TOP BAR: Back arrow (ghost, navy #003F8C, active) left. No skip link.
PROGRESS: 4 horizontal dots. Dots 1-3: green (#22C55E) filled. Dot 4: orange (#FF8A34) filled.
SUBTITLE: 'Periksa data sebelum dikirim ke admin' centered, slate #64748B, 16px.
SUMMARY SECTIONS: 3 collapsible/read-only cards, each with pencil edit icon (navigates back to that step):
SECTION 1 — Personal Info: Name, Phone, Email, Photo thumbnail
SECTION 2 — Professional: Specializations, Locations, Price, Response Hours, Online Coaching toggle
SECTION 3 — Documents: KTP ✓, NPWP ✓, Certificates (count), Experience Photos (count), Testimonials
AGREEMENT: Checkbox row — checkbox (orange when checked) + 'Saya menyetujui TrialFit Buddy Agreement' (link to PDF). Required.
E-SIGNATURE: Label 'Tanda Tangan Digital'. Box area (300x150px, dashed border #E2E8F0). Draw with mouse/touch OR type name (toggle 'Ketik nama'). Clear button. Preview shows signature. Required.
CTA: 'Submit for Review' — orange (#FF8A34), full width, large. Disabled: gray #CBD5E1 until agreement checked + signature present.
SUCCESS STATE (separate mockup): Green checkmark circle, 'Application Submitted!', 'Admin akan review dalam 24 jam', estimated timer.
notes: IDENTICAL LAYOUT to other steps. Summary is read-only with edit links. E-signature supports draw OR type. CTA only enables when agreement checked AND signature present. Success state shows as separate screen mockup.
